name: Pinball Arcade: Hurricane
storyline: Hurricane (1991) was designed by Barry Oursler and features an amazing carnival theme. The playfield features excellent shot flow and all of the great attractions you would see at a real carnival. These include two ramps representing the Hurricane and Comet Roller Coasters, a Dunk the Dummy target, shooting gallery targets and two Ferris wheels, which actually carry the ball on the playfield! A revolving wheel on the back glass gives awesome Mystery Score awards. Williams really takes you on a wild ride with Hurricane! 2,875 units of this table were produced.
